text: LOAN APPLICATION. Applicant: Maria Lopez, age 34. Credit score 690. Annual income $82,000, employed full time for 6 years. Requested FHA purchase loan $240,000 with 3.5% down. DTI 38%. Credit history: Chapter 7 bankruptcy discharged 14 months ago; all accounts current since.

Liabilities: student loan with a $40,000 outstanding balance, currently in deferment; the credit report shows no monthly payment amount and no payment documentation is available.

LOAN APPLICATION. Applicant: Sofia Mendes, age 39. Credit score 730. Annual income $95,000 plus rental income from an investment property she has owned for only 1 year. Requested FHA loan $300,000. DTI 36% counting the full rental income.

LOAN APPLICATION. Applicant: Kevin O'Brien, age 43. Credit score 668. Annual income $69,000, employed 7 years. Requested FHA refinance loan $215,000. Mortgage payment history on the current home in the last 12 months shows three payments that were more than 30 days late.

LOAN APPLICATION. Applicant: Hannah Wright, age 35. Credit score 782. Annual income $120,000, employed 10 years with the same employer, W-2 income verified.
